optionDescriptions.onBeforeChange: Runs before a change is committed; can veto it.
optionDescriptions.onKeyDown: Wraps key handling before the keymap.
optionDescriptions.onLinkClick: Runs when a link in the content is clicked.
optionDescriptions.onLinkOpen: Runs before a link is opened.
optionDescriptions.onSanitizeViolation: Runs for each thing the sanitizer removed.
